scope: Sanitized diagnostic and test evidence; no QQ message body, credential, or generated response is included.

source_journal.diagnostic_read_scope: Only newest segment parsed for event metadata; other segments stat only.

observed_incident.timing_qualification: 13-14 seconds is the observed pre-accept delay from existing trace and journal timestamps, not a separately rerun production microbenchmark. Full verified history scan was not repeated during Runtime recovery.

root_cause: QQTurnIngress._historical synchronously reverse-scanned and verified all journal records for every absent new QQ event identity, blocking the Runtime event loop before event_accepted.

fix.startup: Two sequence-only maps are populated during the already-existing constructor _sync_command_index pass.
fix.steady_state_missing: O(new journal records) incremental catch-up, then dictionary miss; zero historical page reads when cursor is current.
fix.existing_identity: At most two bounded hash-verified sparse seeks for original accepted and completed records.
fix.fallback: Original injected supervisor compatibility fallback retained; production Runtime supplies qq_turn_history.

isolated_new_lookup_benchmark.description: Calls exact production RuntimeSupervisor.qq_turn_history with settled metadata boundary taken from the read-only production journal. A guard rejects any journal page read. This is an isolated lookup benchmark, not a live restored Runtime request benchmark.

pytest.command: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/test_runtime_qq_turn_index.py tests/test_runtime_command_index.py tests/test_shared_qq_homeostasis.py tests/test_qq_direct_source.py tests/test_qq_capability_runtime.py -q

new_regressions: 100 missing identities with all historical page reads forbidden
restart recovery returns original evicted acceptance/completion using two exact seeks
incremental direct journal appends and latest completion
later same-identity acceptance does not inherit an old completion

deployment: Source fixed and handed to parent for Runtime-only reload; this probe performs no service mutation, journal write, message replay, or QQ send.
